About Our Team :

We are a team of three developers participating in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. We are passionate about technology, problem-solving, innovation, and exploring how software can help us better understand the universe.

For the Planet X and SPHEREx challenge, we aim to build an interactive web application that makes astronomical data easier to explore and helps users visualize changes in the sky over time.

Let's explore the universe together and turn data into discovery!
summary:
ASTRAVIEW is an interactive astronomy platform built for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, centered on NASA’s SPHEREx mission and the exploration of near-infrared observations of the sky. The project turns official SPHEREx and IRSA archive data into a visual, searchable experience that helps users explore the universe over time, identify changes in celestial objects, and compare observations from different dates. It is designed to make real astronomical data understandable to both researchers and the general public by combining image viewing, time-based comparison, and science-focused analysis in one interface.
At the core of the app is a React frontend that lets users browse SPHEREx observations by detector, release, date, and sky position, open FITS images in a dedicated viewer, and compare multi-epoch observations to spot temporal change. The system is backed by an Express server that interfaces with NASA/IPAC IRSA services and public S3 archive endpoints, indexing observation metadata and retrieving science images and cutouts. It supports scientific image processing such as astronomical stretches, colormaps, zoom and pan, and sky-coordinate overlays; it also includes logic for detecting compatible observation pairs and running sky-aligned comparisons between them.
details:
ASTRAVIEW – Exploring the Universe Through Time

ASTRAVIEW is an interactive astronomical platform developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, addressing the Planet X / Sphere X challenge.

The platform makes real NASA SPHEREx mission data accessible and easier to explore through interactive visualization of infrared astronomical observations. Using authentic scientific data from NASA's Infrared Science Archive (IRSA), ASTRAVIEW allows users to explore astronomical images, visualize different infrared observations, and compare sky images captured at different times.

With advanced image processing and visualization tools, users can examine celestial objects, explore changes in their appearance, and investigate astronomical phenomena involving comets, asteroids, stars, and other objects.

ASTRAVIEW aims to bridge the gap between complex astronomical datasets and accessible scientific exploration, transforming real space observations into an interactive experience for students, astronomy enthusiasts, and researchers.

Our mission: Making the universe easier to explore, one observation at a time.
